strongest_confirmed_findings: New extraction from August 12 financials: June assets not yet in use $7.8364B versus $2.4174B at December 31, a $5.419B increase and 55.38% of June gross PP&E. This measures broad commissioning capital, not paid-for idle chips or impairment.

Accounting depreciation starts ready-for-use while qualifying interest is capitalized. Note 12 capitalized $59.6M H1 debt interest; competitive obsolescence and economic financing carry can exist before accounting depreciation. Their amount is not disclosed.

July $775M secured facility is backed by deployed GPUs and investment-grade customer cash flows. The unfinished asset pool cannot be equated with that collateral; exact GPU/debt/residual-value mapping remains missing.
October 1 Inferize acquisition supplies primary evidence of operational GPU idle time from model loading/scaling and standby reserves. No measured fleet idle fraction or purchase price was released.

October 15 issuer status: EU-WEST2 InfiniBand GPU-cluster connectivity incident under monitoring at 13:13 UTC, with recovery still in progress. GPU count, MW and monetary impact undisclosed; recheck resolution tonight.
investable_read_through: Monitor commissioning time, cash carry and collateral eligibility even with strong customer demand. The disclosed unfinished asset pool is a capital-at-risk proxy, not evidence of credit impairment or a count of stranded chips. Software efficiency may release productive capacity without adding physical MW, but savings are unquantified.
contradictions_to_prior_assumptions: Not all unfinished PP&E is paid-for GPU inventory.
July secured borrowing refers to deployed GPUs, not the entire unfinished pool.
Historical PUE excludes commissioning months and does not reveal idle capital.
Book depreciation and debt coupons alone understate the scope of possible economic carry; economic value loss remains unmeasured.
